about.title: The strength behind every structure.
about.body: Founded in New Cairo in 2009, Sermix has grown into one of Greater Cairo's most-trusted ready-mix suppliers. We design, batch, and dispatch concrete tuned to the spec, and we test every batch in our own lab so the ticket you sign is the ticket the engineer signs off on.

whyChooseUs.title: Built for spec. Tested at every step.

01.title: Tested every batch
01.body: Compressive-strength cubes pulled from every load and tracked against the ticket, no batch leaves the plant without a record.

02.title: Accredited testing lab
02.body: Our own 28-day testing cycle, no third-party delays. Engineers see results when they need them, not when an outside lab gets to them.

03.title: Two batching plants
03.body: Giving it double the output and continuous, uninterrupted operation a production capability no other company in the area can match.

04.title: On time, around the clock
04.body: 24/7 operations sequenced with the customer. Night pours, fast-track schedules, and continuous deliveries are routine, not exceptional.

hero.title: What Sermix delivers, and how every load is accounted for.
hero.lede: Ready-mix concrete is the product. The lab, the weighbridge, the dispatch desk, and the maintenance workshop are what makes it a service.

cta.title: Tell us what the pour needs.

hero.title: We've been pouring Cairo's foundations since 2009.
hero.lede: Sermix is a New Cairo ready-mix supplier serving contractors and project managers across Egypt. We design, batch, test, and deliver concrete tuned to the engineer's spec, and we own every link in that chain.

story.title: From the plant to the customer's handover
story.p1: Sermix opened in 2009 with a single batching plant in New Cairo and a small fleet of mixers. The brief was simple: deliver concrete on spec, on time, every load, and put a lab on site so every batch can be traced back to a number,
story.imageAlt: Sermix mixer at the batching plant

facilities.title: What we bring to a pour.

plant.title: Batching plant
plant.body: Computer-controlled batching with material certifications kept on file. Capacity tuned for Cairo's daily build cycle, daytime structural, night-shift infrastructure.

lab.title: On-site testing lab
lab.body: An accredited in-house lab ready for all tests, continuously calibrated by external bodies.

fleet.title: Fleet and dispatch
fleet.body: Mixers of 10 m³ running 24/7 from the New Cairo plant, sequenced through a calibrated weighbridge so every load is logged twice, at batch and at site.

hero.title: Order ready-mix concrete.
hero.lede: Tell us the spec, the volume, and when you need it on site. Dispatch will come back within the hour during operating windows with confirmation and a delivery slot.

submit.title: Submit
submit.body: Send us the project, the mix grade, and the volume. The fuller the brief, the faster the reply.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.body: Dispatch validates the request, checks plant capacity for your slot, and comes back with a quote.

design.title: Design
design.body: Our lab finalises the mix design against your spec, slump, strength, and any admixtures you need.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: Truck rotation booked, weighbridge logged, and on-site contact briefed before the first load leaves.
